orientation.central_question: How does this policy turn its general purpose into an enforceable rule?
orientation.one_sentence_answer: The policy states a governing rule, identifies the affected conduct, and applies that rule to the detailed category.
takeaways: The overview introduces the governing rule.
The detailed category applies the same rule in context.
Interpretation requires linking the general statement to the detailed provision.

groups.title: Scope and rule
groups.summary: The general purpose and governing requirement.

groups.title: Application
groups.summary: How the detailed category applies and limits the rule.

concepts.title: Policy purpose
concepts.statement: The overview establishes the conduct the policy is intended to govern.
details: It supplies the context for the numbered rule.
concepts.recall_cue: What behavior is the document trying to govern?

concepts.title: General rule
concepts.statement: The numbered statement expresses the primary obligation in direct form.
details: Its numbering should be preserved for cross-reference.

concepts.title: Detailed category
concepts.statement: The category places the general rule inside a more specific part of the policy.
details: The repeated wording is interpreted in its local context.
concepts.recall_cue: Where is the general rule applied?

concepts.title: Interpretation boundary
concepts.statement: A summary occurrence must not replace the more detailed occurrence when reading the rule.
details: Page provenance distinguishes overview from detail.
concepts.recall_cue: Which occurrence carries the detailed context?

relations.label: gives the rule its purpose
relations.why: The overview supplies context for the obligation.

relations.label: is applied in the category
relations.why: The category repeats and contextualizes the numbered rule.

relations.label: requires the detailed occurrence
relations.why: The detailed occurrence has page-local context absent from the overview.

logic_chain: Read the overview to identify purpose.
Use the detailed category to interpret its application.

distinctions.rule: The overview summarizes; the detailed category supplies the local context for application.

recall_prompts: What obligation does the policy state?
How does the detailed category change interpretation?
Why should repeated wording retain page provenance?
